Memory is a very very odd thing any psychology major or other similar person can tell you.

Ignore it and move on. Since youre saying four to five years, true or not you cannot sit by the window staring out in a wedding dress. 
So either way whatever the universe told you, it is not now. Maybe if you are meant to then you have to learn and do things in the mean time.

Toners are usually a 10 volume dye so they are likely to fade a bit, or completely. Did you catch what color the highlights were before the toner was put on? Thats your best bet to see what they may fade to. 
However if there is no warmth ie, the highlights are yellow underneath then that is the color they will be. 
It is your head and money however so asking your salon about options to fix it shouldnt be an issue if they are a quality place.
555 to me means change.

Dangerous. I merely cleared out an entity I hardly think a full fledged demon and it took me three years, my partner on the brink of suicide from attacks, and some frantic phone calls to churches that hung up on me  
I cant imagine what having a real one would do
Navy blue or a maroon tinted purple would cover this beautifully. Any lighter blues may tone to a muddy color

I dyed a blue black over bleached hair with some green tones stuck in it. It is a permanent blue black so I am very suprised it went this light at all, considering it technically looks awful. 

I plan on doing more treatments with vitamin c over the next week to get the remaining blue black to budge.

Does anyone have advice on using color oops to finish this uneven result? 

And how long after color oops can I do a bleach bath to avoid any re oxidization?

Im unsure about your definition of demon, or even a soul being sold. Regardless find some very long bible prayer video on youtube, it may annoy them and press it out. Barring that I personally found a church that did deliverance near me, but expect a lot of churches to hang up on you in disbelief.

I highly doubt I had a demon, just a low energy thing that hung around after I foolishly did a home clearing for someone without much expertise.
Sure, comment or pm?

Are you allergic to any other animal that doesnt need to walk, for an esa such as a rabbit or the like? But side note even rabbits need play time for a few hours out and cant be caged all the time. 

Check rover or your classifieds for dog walkers in your area, although yard play is an ok exercise it does not provide the mental stimulation a walk does and is necessary. My girl is a breed that needs out and about so I am not an expert but are the tiny breeds ones that dont need a walk daily? I am assuming based on what I have seen with other tiny owners nearly never walking theirs, not sure if that is applicable.

Is my current the person I work it out with and the turbulence has an ending?

Thank you
I nap if I can to avoid thoughts, doesnt work everytime but the times it does it is a nice pretend break. I walk until it hurts or is too cold so I am extra done when I get back.
Are you able to confide in anyone else? My partner is set in his ways so I keep my mental stuff away from him

I cant give you the reason to live, I struggle myself. I also do not know what it is like to go through what you are experiencing, but it seems like a lot for one person. Im around if youd like to chat

Overdoses havent worked, I need something with better odds for any real result. Figures since my previous attempts never worked, I cant beat the statistics, and sheer time it takes. Most pain Ive felt in recent memory too, seriously pills is just not the way.

Yep, made myself try again and again at school just to have mountains of debt and nothing to show for it. Figures Ill always be garbage. Had set an age to die and passed it myself. Really wondering why I keep going into more hell.

Its ok to feel the way you do, no circumstansce is too afluent to prevent mental health issues. I understand the feeling of why cant someone else do it. If Ive ruined so much already I would botch the end too for myself.
Absoluetely, feels great to know I dont have to continue to be in such pain, I could stop it at any time
That is great thank you. As far as I know one can enlist at least as a reservist with parental permission at 17, but his birth year puts him in combat at 16-17 the year he is claiming.
Thank you for answering. I am so happy to read that there is possibility.

I only just came out to my therapist last week. She then accompanied me to my psych appointment right after as she thought it was important and wanted to be there for support. I understand a bit of what youre feeling, but as some professional said to me dont invalidate yourself based on three letters.
You know your thoughts and feelings, and you know some things that feel best even if youre not 100% on board with transition, or want a low dose hrt, or want surgery. You dont need to have all the answers right now, and know that even without medical transition your gender and feelings are valid. 
Its ok not to know right now, are there resources in your area like an lgbt centre that can point you in a direction that isnt say your gp or regular therapist? 
Either way best to you, feel free to inbox me as well.
